questions.prompt: "Waiting on the sponsor's parts order" is holding up five different tasks across the project. What should you use?
questions.explanation: A blocker is a reusable, project-scoped reason that can be attached to many tasks at once. Resolving it once detaches it from every task and recomputes each of their statuses. A dependency is the wrong tool — it links exactly two tasks.

answers.text: A blocker, attached to all five tasks
Five dependencies pointing at one placeholder task
A comment on each of the five tasks

questions.prompt: You attach a blocker to a task that is currently IN_PROGRESS. What happens to its status?
questions.explanation: Attaching a blocker forces the task to BLOCKED. It returns to TODO only once it has no open blockers and no unfinished dependencies — the system will not silently leave it looking active while it is stuck.

answers.text: It stays IN_PROGRESS with a warning icon

questions.prompt: A milestone's health badge says "at risk." What does that mean?
questions.explanation: At risk is a forecast, not a verdict: the date has not passed, but at the current rate the milestone will not make it. It is useful precisely because there is still time to move a date, add people, or cut scope.

answers.text: It hasn't missed its date yet, but at the current rate it won't make it
Its date has already passed with work still open
Nobody has been assigned as its owner
It has fewer than three linked tasks

questions.prompt: A milestone has gone red — past its date with tasks still open. What's the right response?
questions.explanation: Open it, look at what's still there, and either finish the work or change the date deliberately. A milestone nobody has moved and nobody has finished stops carrying information for everyone who reads the board.

answers.text: Open it and either finish the remaining work or move the date on purpose
Delete it and create a fresh one so the board looks clean
Leave it — the badge will clear itself on the next refresh
Unlink the unfinished tasks from it

questions.prompt: A milestone's progress bar is a judgement call made by the system.
questions.explanation: False. The bar is plain arithmetic — linked tasks done over linked tasks total. The health badge beside it is the judgement, and it is recalculated every morning from what's left, how much time remains, and whether anything linked is overdue or blocked.
